QuestInfo.name: Samurai Skirmish 1
QuestInfo.0: Motonari has an important task for you.
QuestInfo.1: Oda's forces have been spotted near Momijigaoka again. They're probably just scouts, but you shouldn't let them report back to their master.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Oda's scouts with a lightning-fast attack, but he still has a massive army at his command.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,955\nCan proceed to the Samurai Skirmish 2 quest

0.0: The falcon returns. You have no doubt realized that Oda knows where we are. His men are practically swarming the eastern reaches of our base.
0.1: It is only a matter of time before he descends upon Momijigaoka, and we will not last the day if that happens.
0.2: We must act first. To wait for luck is to wait for death. Will you grace us with your sword?

yes.0: I knew you would be willing to acquiesce. Go to Momijigahara 1, and take care of the enemy forces there.

no.0: We cannot wait for the enemy to establish a base. This mission is critical to our success.

1.0: How goes the attack? Do not tarry.

yes.0: The enemy will only grow stronger. We cannot afford for any one man to under-perform.

default.0: Hurry to Momijigahara 1 and take care of the Oda Soldiers. I would like fifty, but feel free to dispatch more if you are able.
